description: Get a single email message by ID. Returns the HTML body (and a plain-text version), sender, recipients, attachments, and reply-to info for composing a response. You can pass either messageId or threadId — they are the same value.

boardId.description: The board ID the message belongs to

messageId.description: The message/thread ID to retrieve (same value used for both)

threadId.description: Alias for messageId — use either one (they are interchangeable)

name: get_thread
title: Read a thread
